scope: Diffuse cutaneous systemic sclerosis: autoimmunity, endothelial injury, fibroblast activation and skin fibrosis, with interstitial lung disease and renal crisis branches. Mixed-subset SSc studies retain their context; excludes limited cutaneous disease, morphea and overlap syndromes.

paragraphs.text: TGF-beta1 stimulation increased COL1A1 expression in cultured skin fibroblasts. ATA IC exposure increased endothelial TGF-beta1 secretion. ATA-conditioned endothelial medium increased fibroblast COL1A1 expression.

These selected findings describe a bounded candidate, whose overall explanation has not been independently checked against current literature. Expression is not a clinical fibrosis endpoint. Selected full-text result; not a property of all specificities. Treatment efficacy has not been synthesized in this summary.
